nom: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream for Dark Circles

avis.texte: I purchased this eye cream for the first time and it gave me a light burning sensation immediately after applying. I thought maybe my skin was just not used to it, so I tried it for a second night and again had the burning sensation. The next day my eyes felt very irritated. I came to look at reviews and saw several recent reviews complaining of a burning sensation. My eyes went back to normal after I stopped using this product. Will definitely return and hopefully they investigate what is going on!

I had terrible burns and stinging around my eyes after using. I thought I needed to see an eye doctor. I stopped using and it went away after a couple of weeks. I have NEVER had a reaction like this to any eye cream or face cream. Some fragrances or sunscreen additives sting or make my eyes water, but I have NEVER had a product burn the skin around my eyes. I experienced this with BOTH advanced Night Repair eye products! Something is wrong in these formulations that it can physically burn skin as you sleep!

This product needs examined and tested by the company for consideration of recall. I used this product 3 or 4 times and now have burns and puffiness around my eyes. I also have a burst blood vessel in the white part of my eye. I am so frustrated to read that several other people have had this same experience very recently. Something is wrong with this product and it needs handled by the company. My product came from the Holiday collection gift.

I have been a representative for Estée Lauder in the past at multiple locations, for 6+years. It is one of my favorite brands up until now. They have altered this formula, or, are distributing a bad batch KNOWINGLY. There are many people in the reviews with the same CHEMICAL BURNS on their eyes as I received from this 75$ product. Absolutely unacceptable. The way they handled this as well, just throwing me a refund and then ignoring any inquiry to their plans going forward is a disgraceful response to causing women PAIN, suffering, and a rash they have to deal with on their face for months. I received a chemical burn on my eyes from this cream that took 2 months to clear up, and that is with a prescription from a doctor. I am truly shocked that they have not addressed this or pulled the product for investigation. The Estée I used to know? That would have been their immediate response to multiple women getting PAINFUL BURNS, that do not heal for weeks going on months. I would not recommend this product, and as a past sales rep I would not recommend Estée Lauder PERIOD until they handle this professionally vs. sweeping it under the rug. DO NOT BUY. They do not care that they're burning the eyes and faces of paying customers.

This eye gel is wonderful! It feels like satin on your skin and is long lasting. A little goes a very long way! I would recommend 10 out of 10. There aren't enough good things to say about this product.

Wanted to like this product, but after a couple days use it caused red blistering under my eyes. It was hard to believe it was caused by this product considering I have comfortably used both retinol and glycolic acid-based products under my eyes before, but every time I would try and use it again after my skin would heal, the blistering would return. Very disappointing, so glad this was a gift and not something I paid for.

I love the Estée Lauder product line and has used for over ten years. This is the first time that I've had a bad experience. This supercharged eye gel burned the skin on and around my eyes as well as produced swelling. I will not use any other such products from Estée Lauder and just stick to their cleaners and moisturizers. I just noticed that many others have reported a similar experience.

I have never had a bad experience with Estée Lauder until I used this. I experienced burning and brushed it off as my skin being sensitive. However later the skin under my eyes started itching and burning. Later that day my eye area was puffy with welts. I woke up with even more puffiness, irritation, and discoloration it feels like a burn and very dry,

Just like a lip balm makes your lips feel soft and supple, this "gel" soaks into my eye area skin and leaves it feeling moisturized, not greasy/oily. It's still very lightweight. After just 2 weeks I can see fewer lines, less puffiness and bags. A little goes a very long way. I will absolutely buy again.

I have used the Advanced Repair Gel-Creme for over a year. This is undoubtedly the best product I have ever used. It is so soft and slides on and around the eye easily. Dryness on the lids is sometimes very hard to get rid of This product does the trick along with minimizing fine lines and darkness under eyes. You can't go wrong using this product.
10/10 recommend! I use it every night and it's helped with my dark circles.
I won't be purchasing again. I have sensitive skin and had a negative reaction to the product. Not saying don't buy, I use other estee products .

I was so excited to try my new products, especially this gel-creme. After a few days of use, first I started to experience itchy eyes.At first, I thought it was due to seasonal allergies. However, the itching progressed to burning on the outside. I was on vacation and fortunately my eye doctor called in a prescription for antibiotic eye drops. I continued however using the product becuase I had no idea it was causing my issues. When we got back from vacation, I was still having the symptoms and went to the eye doctor. They tried a different prescription. A few nights later I was awakened feeling like the skin around my eyes was on fire. I had used the gel that night before bed as I have been since I got it. That morning, my left eye was swollen, I had a like a welt-like area in the corner of my left eye, both eyes under the eyes were fiery red, and they burned to the touch. In that moment, I realized that the only thing different I had been doing was using this product! I stopped using it.Later than day, my skin started to wrinkle up under my eye and the skin looked scaly. As the days progressed, I had to deal with ugly scaling scabs under my eyes which made work very difficult as I am on virtual meetings daily. It's now a week later, and my skin is still peeling, and occassionally buring in the more burned areas. I'm very disappointed after reading these reviews that the salesperson did not alert me to the possibilities of being burned, instead was more in sales mode. It's v
I've used Advanced Night Repair products for many years. There is absolutely nothing any better.

I've never been sensitive to any products or makeup but this caused dry, flaking, eczema-like symptoms under my eyes. Once I pinpointed the cause and stopped using, thankfully it resolved. I see many other reviews also had such problems.

I would never use this again. Caused a chemical burn under my eyes. Not joking, it literally looked like I had two black eyes. It also took the entire top coat off of my dip manicure on the finger I used to get it out of the container which is pretty wild!

avis.titre: Estée Lauder Super charged gel cream
avis.texte: After using Estée Lauder for 21 years, I have to say the new eye cream is absolutely horrible. It made my eyelids red and inflamed and felt like a chemical burn. . I received mine with the gift with purchase in November, and i had no idea Estée had changed the eye cream. The new ingredients are too strong and from all of the remarks on here, I see I am not the only one with the same reaction. You are going to lose a lot of good customers with this new and improved eye cream, including me !

I used this for about a week and a half with no issues, and then suddenly I woke up with my eyes extremely red, dry and peeling like crazy. This went on for several days. I had to treat them with vitamin E oil to get my skin back on track. Since switching to Advanced Night Repair, I haven't had any problems so far!
Horrible burn under eyes. Really thought this would be great but ended up wasting money along with a doctors visit and more money spent on prescription ointment to heal it.
After the first use I had burning and irritation. I gave it to my husbad and he has no issues with it.

I received this in a sample kit with my Estée Lauder order and now have what I thought was dermatitis under my eyes until I read other reviews and see others having this same issue. I don't have sensitive skin and have never had anything like this before. Maybe it was a bad batch? It itches like crazy and burns.
This eye cream left a burning sensation under my eyes. Would not recommend.

I used this product for about two weeks and then woke up to red, burning eyes with dry, crusty areas in my outer and inner eyes. I immediately stopped using the product and days later I am still dealing with it. There isn't any retinol in this product so I am not sure what is causing these issues, but I see from other reviews that I'm not alone. I will be returning the product.

I dont have sensitive skin but this cream burned my under eye and it's flaky and i cant even wear makeup because it seperates and starts flaking . I never had a product do this to me. It was good for the first couple times i used it so idk what happend, then i go on tiktok ans see similar experiences. Sucks that it didnt do this till after the return window 🥲
This caused chemical burns and gave me more lines under my eyes plus skin pealing would not recommend

avis.titre: This is the best thing I have ever found!
avis.texte: It does cost more but so worth it. I have seen a difference in my aging skin! All of their products are amazing!
Horrible! It burned the skin around my eye and I'm not sensitive to products ever. Returned after the first use.

I was really excited to try the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Supercharged Gel Cream, especially because I got it as part of a gift set and assumed that the price reflected a high-quality product. The first time I used it, I didn't notice any issues. The next day, my eyes felt a little puffy, but I attributed it to lack of sleep. By the third day, however, I noticed tingling and a burning sensation under my eyes. I stopped using the cream to let my skin recover and even adjusted my skincare routine to see if it was interacting with other products, but the burning persisted. Eventually, the irritation worsened and turned into what felt like a chemical burn, leaving my under-eye area red and puffy. Thankfully, the skin did not break. I cannot comment on the ingredients, but based on my experience, this product did not work for me and I would not recommend it.

Skip this one. It is not worth risking an allergic reaction. I have itchy and scaling skin on my eyelid and on both of the outer corners of my yes. There is a red bump on one side of the eye corner along with a burning sensation.I woke up with a very irritated eye lid after using this product for about 2 weeks...it kept getting worse, but I didn't think it was the product. I stopped using it and it started to improve the next day. Others have also had this problem. This product came as as a sample size with an order.

Wow.. what a disappointment and I see that I am not the only one! Wish I had read the reviews before my purchase. I am sorry to everyone that had this happen to.. it is very painful and uncomfortable..

I never leave reviews of products, but i was gifted this over the holidays and ive used this gel creme before, but suddenly i started experiencing burning, redness, itchyness and swollen undereyes. Turns out they've reformulated this product and im not the only one experiencing this! Please stay away from this product!!
This caused chemical burns under my eyes that took almost a week of care to heal.

I recieved a sample of this eye cream as a free gift. After using it the first time, i thought under my eyes apprared swollen/puffy. I tried it again, and after a couple hours my eyes were burning and watering. I had to rinse them with saline it was so discomforting. This is why i only purchase creams, gels, and serums from my esthetician.

I got chemical burns 3 times from this. After looking online it seems I'm not the only one to have this happen to. When I first got the product I was using it a few times a week with no problems, but about 3 months ago I put it on and it started burning really bad, so I rinsed it off. About a day later I woke up with blisters under both my eyes. I thought it was due to me using a wash cloth on my face and causing micro tears in my skin. I waited for them to heal and tried again, making sure to be very gentle when cleaning my face and to not mix it with another product. A day later and I had redness and flaking skin for a few days. I figured I didn't wait long enough for the skin to fully heal. I waited about a month before trying again, and a day later I've got redness again. It could be that I'm doing something wrong, or my skin is too sensitive for this product, but I've used many different products before and nothing like this has happened.

I received a sample size ofthis eye cream as part of free gift with purchase. I liked the results so ordered a full size. After one week, the area under my eyes became very irritated, red and scaly. I've never had a reaction to any skin care products before, but am very dissatisfied with this product. I'm hoping the discoloration and scaliness/flakiness improves soon, as that area looks much worse now than it did before I used the product. Maybe something changed in the formulation since I used the free sample?

If you have any potential for sensitivity, stay away. I did great the first few usages, but then realized on the fourth day that I had swollen, darker colored areas and marks like scars below both eyes. It was odd. I've never had this type of reaction, and I'm now out of a lot of $$$ because of it. I would not recommend it to anyone for use near their eyes.

I don't have sensitive skin but this caused a scaly burning rash around my eyes. It's very concerning that the instructions say to use it around the whole eye are but in the Q&A it says it is only for the under eyes. The only place this is going is in the garbage.

This came in the holiday gift set. I never have issues with products so I didnt think to check reviews…it was about 3 days in my under eyes were burning really bad. Once I got a closer look there were nasty bumps, it was swollen and scaly. It's been 3 days since I stopped using it and it still looks terrible. It makes my crows feet look 10x worse and skin is now peeling! Gross

I loved this at first. Then, after several days of use, my eyes started burning. And it has gotten progressively worse. I have had a couple other eye creams do this. But this is another one for the no column.
Its almost 26$ very tiny package if it works good also littlr fine but its burning feel and im getting tears after using package was too small

I got this as part of a holiday kit I purchased and after a couple of users it caused under my eyes to burn and get red and caused wrinkles to form. There is something not right with this product.... several of us are having the same allergic reaction to this product....I expected so much better from EL.

avis.titre: Skip this, do yourself a favor
avis.texte: I had a sample size of this and loved it for the first two weeks I used it, so much that I went ahead and bought another to have as a backup. After two weeks I started to notice a small red rash forming under both my eyes. The eye cream was the only change I had made to my routine. After the picture I attached, it turned into a full rash under my eye. I immediately stopped using it after I noticed the initial rash but the damage was done. Its been a week since this picture and under my eyes is still painful but is looking much better. Save your money and your under eyes. It was super disappointing because I use the face wash from this same line and never had any issues.

I've used multiple eye creams and decided to splurge on this one. After one use, the skin under my eyes and along my bottom lash line were red, dry, and puffy. I never used again but it took several days for my skin to get back to normal.

I received this eye cream in my Holiday Blockbuster set in December. I've noticed if I use it for a few consecutive days, I develop a red dry scaly patches at the corner and underneath the eye. I did this pattern twice and found the eye cream was the culprit. I decided to see if there were any reviews stating the same thing or if it was my own human error. I don't know if this cream is just a bad batch or if it's just not the one for me. I will definitely have to have a sample of something different before I try another eye cream ever. This however, is the only problem I've ever encountered with any Estée Lauder products.

Been using the advanced night repair serum for 25 years on and off and love it! This product on the other hand, hate it! after a short period of time using it I developed a contact dermatitis spot on the inner eyelid. Swollen and irritated. Definitely do not recommend !

I received this product as part of the Holiday set I purchased in 2025. This product has caused a severe allergic reaction. The outer corner of my eyes are red and raw, and my eyelids are dry and burning. I called customer service to discuss what can be done to fix this situation. I was told that my order was over 70 days old, so I'm ineligible for a refund. I will never order directly from Estee Lauder again.
I have used various eye creams over the years with no issues. Unfortunately, this cream left me with chemical burns.

I had been using this for 2 months and then put of the blue it started burning creating red, sensitive, dry, patchy skin around my eyes. caused my eye lid to swell the other eye swelled underneath my eye. had to see dr to get prescription to heal the damage. now outer eyes have red discoloration for the rash that finally healed. Dr said it was dermatitis
My under eyes are extremely dry and irritated. Scales and wrinkles that are more prominent than I had before. Burned my skin!
The purpose of this eye cream is to brighten dark circles, but after using It seems it can hydrate the skin around the eyes. It also has a little improvement in the wrinkles. Cool.

avis.titre: Love this eye night time gel
avis.texte: I love this night time eye gel, it's my favorite! I don't know how anyone can give it a bad review. It never once burned my skin under my eyes. Love this product!

Like many others I developed the WORST dermatitis/burns around and under my eyes from using this product. I would never rec or risk it given that it seems to happen often. This is my first time having a reaction like this to a skin product.
Majority of my skin care producrs are Estee Lauder, but this product ruined the skin under my eyes!

avis.titre: Read the reviews - how is this still on the market?!
avis.texte: I wish I had read the other reviews before using this eye gel. This was included in the holiday gift set and I was excited to try it. After a couple of nights, my undereyes became very irritated, flaky, and SO painful. There was a constent burning sensation. I have never had any issues with any product like this before. It took me a few days to realize this product was the culprit and it took weeks after of very gentle moisturizing to get the burns to go away. I have wrinkles now that I didn't before and I still can't wear concealer without it looking patchy and crusty. Avoid this product if you don't want to look like you doused yourself with acid.
Love Estee Lauder night repair eye gel cream. Have used it for years.

avis.titre: Eye cream should not give me chemical burns
avis.texte: CHEMICAL BURNS on my eyelids. They are bright red and burning. It's been 48 hours and they are still just as bright and painful. Don't buy this. Even if someone has sensitive eyes - we all do! Don't make an eye cream that literally burns your eye skin.
This product has caused chemical burns on my eyelids and under eye. I have used this product for years and the recent purchase this by product has caused severe burns.

I wanted something for my under eye area. Mine can get puffy and I have some dark circles. This was really promising at first, it went on smooth and felt nice, but it ended up burning. It really bothered my eyes and I had to take it off. I have not had this issue with other cream. I am glad that I bought on sale, because this product is unusable to me.
Not only did it help with the listed issues, I noticed it shrunk and totally cleared skin tags and sun spots

I normally don't have issues with trying various facial products but I tried this eye cream several years ago and decided to splurge now on it again recently… what a mistake. As soon as I began rubbing it under and around my eyes, the burning sensation started and continued to burn and burn. There was some redness accompied with the burning so I gently washed off what I could and applied my normal moustrizer instead. I love Estee Lauder foundation and other serums but this one really took me by surprise!

avis.titre: Terrible burn, swollen, red and flaking skin
avis.texte: I bought the holiday special and used the cream for ~3 days and developed a terrible reaction - swollen itchy burning skin and lids. It was awful and took 2 weeks to heal with rhe skin flaking for days as it healed while still burning. My skin still isn't fully back to normal. I was able to return it to Ulta without issue (thank you customer service). I use EL concealer and foundation but will never try another skin care product again from EL. This should not be on the market anymore.

avis.titre: Feels like my under eyes are burning
avis.texte: This gel left me with red swollen, burning, weird wrinkled under eyes. It was a horrible looking reaction that really hurt.
Left my under-eye itchy, red, and swollen. I dont have sensitive skin and this happened. I do not reccommend, it hurts.

I initially enjoyed this product / but, recently it left me with irritation and red, swollen undereyes after using it. It was painful and i had to wait days for it to heal. I threw the leftover away, which was expensive. I will never buy this or any other Estee Lauder prduct again
I had the same reaction as many others. My eyes looked burnt and crusty with just 1 application. It was awful. I am disappointed bc I really wanted this product to work.

After using EL foundation and a few other makeup products for a while I bought the holiday bonus to try some of the other products. After 2-3 nights of using the night repair eye gel I woke up with what appeared to be sunburn and extremely swollen/puffy eye. I have always loved the other products I have gotten but definitely would not recommend the eye gel!

avis.titre: big problem with Advanced Night Repair eye product
avis.texte: I've had the same issue as several people that purchased this produce. It made my eyes red, swollen and crusty. I concluded that from the same experience several other people that the batch sold in December 2025 was BAD. I'm out the money because I don't remember how I purchased this but know that I won't be buying any Estée Lauder product again.

Unfortunately I didn't get a chance to see the results. I developed burns/extreme skin irritation around my eyes. There were red patches surrounding my eyes and my skins was peeling off. The healing process was not pretty. There were raw, red patches for about 5-7 days. It was uncomfortable and embarrassing but it did go away. I will not be trying this product again.
This product burned my skin and left me with inflamed, scaly bumps.

This product left what is almost like a chemical burn around my eyes. I developed red puffy dry patches and almost intensified my wrinkles. I waited too long to start trying this product so unfortunately, I cannot return. I ended up just throwing it away.

This product left what is almost like a chemical burn around my eyes. I developed red puffy dry patches and almost intensified my wrinkles. I waited too long to start trying this product so unfortunately, I cannot return. I ended up just throwing it away.

This eye cream doesnt do much at all. I been using it over a month and don't see a difference in my eyes. It very thick but it does absorb pretty well. I use this with another serum eye cream under this one. I won't buy this again.

I'm an oily girl and am just noticing my first signs of aging in my early forties- a couple fine lines around my eyes. This product gave me dermatitis and eczema around my eyes every time I tried it which sucked because I've never had sensitive skin in my life. It was inflamed and red and lasted for weeks- my skin was literally painful to the touch and so irritated that just water stung! I don't recommend this product for anyone, especially those with sensitive skin because the fragrance alone would destroy you. Such a fail from a trusted brand.

I used this eye cream years earlier and it was great. I bought in early December a set of the full size night repair serum and this eye cream. I've only used a couple days and my eyes are red, puffy and wrinkled from it. I checked online reviews and saw many others having this problem. So disappointing to spend too dollar for what is supposed to be a luxury eye cream and have this issue.
Used this product for a couple years now. The last bottle I brought has been making the skin around my eyes inflamed, red and peeling. I will be looking for another brand to use.
This eye cream feels light and absorbs fast. It moisturizes my under-eye area well and makes my eyes look fresh. I like it and would buy it again.

This product significantly burned my entire eye area. My eyes were red and swollen for days after 1 use. I wish I would have read the reviews before trying it. I use many other department store eye products and never had a problem. This is the first time I tried Estee Lauder.

avis.titre: My skin is damaged after using this eye gel
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this eye gel. I bought myself the blockbuster holiday set and could not wait to try everything out. I ignored the bad reviews about this gel causing skin irritation because I do not have sensitive skin. About a week after starting this eye gel, I noticed a small red area under my left eye and what looked like three small pimples under my right eye. I also noticed burning and stinging under my eyes. The red patch under my left eye became extremely dry and scaled, the skin is now starting to flake off, and the three spots under my right eye have become very itchy and my under eye is swollen. I stopped using this product about a week ago and I'm still healing. The skin around my eyes looks terrible right now. So far I have not reacted negatively to the other products I'm using. I actually got a gift set for my sister, too, that includes this product, but I am concerned about her using it because I do not want her to have this happen to her. I think I may just pitch it. I have never had my skin react so badly to any other product I have used in my life. It looks like this works well for a lot of people, so if you buy it, I hope it works for you. I cannot recommend this product due to my experience.

Been an Estee Lauder customer for over 30 years and never had a problem until this product. Ordered a set of full size plus 3 sample sizes hoping to reduce under eye circles. This product inflamed the skin under my eyes, turning it red, flaky and itchy. It actually made the circles more visible! I thought my skin might need to adjust and gave it a fair chance, but it never stopped irritating my skin. Went to a dermatologist who told me I needed to stop using this product! Now I'm stuck with 4 containers of a product I spent good money for and will never use, let alone give to anyone else. Very disappointed.
Fantastic product. I have been using it for over 2 years. Loving it.

This eye cream works really well. It has a fine, smooth texture and absorbs relatively quickly. However, the results don't seem particularly noticeable—when I stop using it, the fine lines appear more prominent again.
This is a very good product, persistently using it makes us younger.

I received the full size in a free gift with purchase. I have only used it for about a week. It goes on nicely and only takes a very small amount. I can't say much about results just yet, but so far, I am liking it.

I don't know if the formula for this product has changed since I bought it before and liked it ok. After using about 1/3 of the jar, the skin under my eyes has become red and crusty. I'm 71 and don't expect miracles but I also don't expect to wake up and look 100! That's what happened this morning.

I tried this for about a mth , it was smooth with no problems but than i broke out under both of my eyes with a bad rash . My skin started looking streched out , dry , itchy , and red . I stopped using and put Aquaphor on it , it eventually went away . Please be cautious

This eye cream at first created extreme puffiness and dark circles. I thought I was just tired, because I couldn't understand why my eyes look this way. And then after a couple of weeks of using the product, I started to burn and be irritated and that's when I realize it was the ice cream.
Great product! I apply at night, but honestly sometimes in the morning too when eyes are looking a bit tired. Disappears in with light touch.

Ive been trying this cream for about a month or two and ive developed such dry, itchy skin under my eyes. Ive never had this beofre in my life and aquaphor is saving me. After reading other reviews, people had similar experiences as me (and I'm not talking 2 or 3 people…im talking minimum 10-12 reviews of this…) DO NOT BUY!!! Not worth your money!!!
A week in and I had a super bad reaction under both eyes. Don't typically have issues with sensitive skin so not sure why this one reacted so badly.

avis.titre: Love the advanced night repair serum, but not this
avis.texte: I love Estée Lauder's Advanced night repair serum. Never have had an issue. But this eye gel-Creme gives me significant dermatitis. I have tried it multiple times, hoping that it was just a coincidence. But I did a trial of it one last time where I used no other products on my eye area, and it had the same reaction. Red, scaly, and itchy/stingy. The inflammation does indeed make the wrinkles around my eyes appear worse which is not ideal! Hopefully will resolve in a few days with aquaphor and a good barrier repair cream.

I love the texture and feel of this. It is not too thin or too thick. Does not feel heavy. Sinks in but you can still feel the hydration hours later. I have only been using for one week and I immediately seen a difference! Does not irritate my eyes. My under eyes look so smooth. I am 59 years old. I use it day and night. I will never be without this now! Worth every penny!
I've been using this for years. Really keeps fine lines to a minimum. Really love it

avis.titre: Beware of a possible reaction to this gel
avis.texte: I used this product one time and experienced a severe reaction of burning and hives under my eyes. It lasted for days and I had to visit my allergist . I have never reacted in this way to a beauty product. Beware.

avis.titre: Do not purchase - totally caused significant irritation
avis.texte: I have used rodan and fields eye crème forever. I switched and tried using this and it has completely irritated both under my eyes and eyelids, huge red circles and puffiness. It's burning and drying, flaky, itchy. I have not been able to wear anything on my eyes for days and the only thing bringing some relief right now is aquaphor and Vaseline. I have NEVER EVER had a skin reaction like this before. I don't have sensitive skin whatsoever. I am seriously concerned about being able to get this under control and it has made my upper eyes significantly more wrinkled. I just purchased a whole bunch of edge lauder and am now worried about all of it as a skin care regimen.

I got the travel size to try and i used a very small new small eyelid brush and applied this product. First day, my eyes already feel very moisturized. I dont have dry itchy eyes. I also noticing a lifting effect aswell. I apply this and some castor oil on my lashes with disposable spoile. Very nice will be purchasing full size.
Developed contact dermatitis, do not recommend. My eyes are swollen and red!

I am a very faithful user of Estee Lauder products and have been for years. I used this serum, or one very like it, a few years ago with no issues. I was super excited to get a sample of it in a gift bag after I ordered another product. I am not sure if the formula has changed or not, but this time around I had a completely different experience. A few hours after the first time I used it, the skin around my eyes started itching and burning so intensely and I immediately had to wash my face with cool water. It took all my willpower to not rub my eyes. It has been a couple of days and I still have very itchy spots, I'm starting to get bags under my eyes, and the skin still feels like it is burning. I am very disappointed in this product because I really do enjoy using the other products.

I tried this product multiple days and every time my eyes felt like tiny needles were injecting into them and put BIG dark circles and lines making me look very old. I am 27. My eyes burnt intensely so I stopped using it. I thought maybe my face wasn't moisturized enough, but sure enough it was and many others have had this same reaction, only I stopped soon enough to not have the worst reaction. My sister on the other hand, did not. She looks horrible, is miserable, and her eyes are so swollen she cannot barely see.
Actually laughed at the product when i received it. Not worth the price with how much product you get.

To preface, I typically love estee products! I've loved this particular eye cream in the past, however, I believe the formula has changed. I put this on last night and woke up to sore, red and puffy eyes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. The cream is light weight and non-greasy. It absorbs fast and does not irritate my eyes. It works great at reducing the fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes. I highly recommend it.

avis.titre: Hydration and Brightness for Tired Eyes
avis.texte: I've really enjoyed using the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Cream Skincare Gift Set over the past few weeks. My under eyes tend to be dry, with dark circles and the beginnings of fine lines, so I was curious to see if these products would make a difference. The serum has a lightweight texture that sinks into my skin quickly without feeling sticky, and the eye gel-creme feels soothing and hydrating with a silky, balmy finish that isn't heavy. With consistent use, I've noticed my under-eye area looks brighter and feels much more moisturized, and my fine lines appear softer. While I mostly use the set at night, I've also applied it during the day under makeup and it layers beautifully without causing any pilling. This set has really helped refresh and revive my eye area. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This brighter eyes set feels like a luxurious addition to my nighttime skincare routine. The main tub has a gel-like texture that can be applied with a small amount under your eyes to smooth, hydrate, and brighten. When I woke up, I felt like my chronic dark circle look minimized and I looked more refreshed. I saw some negative reviews about people having reactions to the product, but my experience was positive. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've tried both Advanced Night Repair Multi-Recovery eye cream and Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream. I have dry, mature skin. And I prefer the Multi-recovery eye cream. This eye cream is thicker and feels like it nourishes and hydrates the skin and locks it in. In the morning, I notice my skin is more hydrated and my wrinkles are less noticeable. I used it for 3 weeks, and I'm very happy with the result so far. It's not scented, but has a subtle earthy scent. This set comes with full size & travel size of eye cream, and travel size serum. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
Timeless beauty starts with self-care ✨ This Estée Lauder eye cream keeps my eyes looking luminous, rested, and refined. #EsteeLauder
After a few days of using this I saw a noticeable difference in the dark under eye circles. I love the consistency of this product...smooth and easy to tap on.

I received a sample jar of this with an order. The pros are that it feels really nice. It is light and not greasy. After using it for about 2 weeks, I noticed a red irritated spot on the outer corner of my eye. I didn't connect it to this immediately but put Aquafor around my eyes for a couple days till it was calmed down. I used it again and when I woke up the rod spot was back even worse and I had 2 irritated spots around my other eye. I gave it to my daughter and let her know it irritated my skin but maybe would work for them. Within 2 days, she also had red spots where it was applied.
I have been using this product for years...........Im glad Ulta has it in stock. I wish they would have the Estee Lauder perfumes too!

Loved using this product! I use it in the evening and it makes my skin feel so soft. I noticed a difference within a few days of using regularly. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes

avis.titre: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cr
avis.texte: It lifts, firms, and smooths. Targets puffiness and fine lines. Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and deeply hydrating.

avis.titre: Soothing and gentle on the skin
avis.texte: This eye cream is very gentle. It applies with an included spatula, so it is very easy to scoop out the right amount without fear of contaminating the bottle with fingers. It also dispenses just enough for both eyes. I didn't detect a scent either. My eye area felt soft, and it also left a firmness to my undereye skin. I apply this at night, but in the morning, the skin around my eye area is still soft, hydrated and it has a slight firmness to it. Overall, a gentle eye cream that you can use nightly and you will wake up to a soft and firm eye area. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I liked how this Estee Lauder improved the appearance of my undereyes after 3 weeks of use. I notice that they look less puffy than what I normally have them. I like that it's easy to apply and that it's absorbed quite quickly on the skin. I would highly recommend using it and I have noticed the results firsthand. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes
Wow I ready love my new eye cream. I see the lift and firming around my eyes happening and the smoothness , and lift scent is great.

I received this product complimentary from Estée Lauder for my testing and review. Firstly I am a huge Estée Lauder fan for many years and find their products really work. This eye cream is refreshing and does help with rejuvenating the eyes especially after a long day. It goes on nice and smooth as well.

Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt has a very light, slippery consistency with a smooth and buttery application. It's a Great eye elixir for those who prefer a lighter and less dense formula.This serum irritated my eyes made them red, gooey, and excessively watery which is very atypical for me. This product may be cost effective as a little goes a long way and the wand is super useful for gaging single applications. However, the bottle I recieved was less than half full. I honestly can't vouch for the product's efficacy. I ran out of product too soon. But it feels fairly nice on the skin and is effortless to apply. Those with oily, breakout-prone complexions may want to avoid this serum as it did cause me blemishes. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder in exchanged for my honest review. This cream is very lightweight and creamy, and my eye area feels so soft and silky after the first application. It is very easy to apply with the included spoon like applicator that helps me to apply at the evening, a little goes a long way. After applying, there is no greasy or oily or residue left behind. I loved how lightweight it feels, super soft, noticed small difference, my under-eyes felt more hydrated and I noticed less puffiness in the morning. I highly recommend the product.
